issue.title: Codex sandbox mode is inherited from the machine config despite the documented override promise
issue.body:
Found by WP-F5 (#102 launch diagnosis) and classified by its independent GPT-6.1 Sol review on 2026-10-19 as a documentation and contract defect. Outside every I01 to I07 bolt; filed for triage.

## Defect

docs/06 (line 83 at `9070207`) and the comment at `packages/adapter-codex/src/options.ts:5` promise that GraphGoblin overrides every behaviour-affecting Codex default so nothing from the machine's `config.toml` leaks into loops. The machine's `[windows] sandbox = "elevated"` setting does reach the Codex sessions GraphGoblin starts through the SDK (observed in the WP-F5 trial session logs and reproduced with `codex sandbox`).

## Expected

Either the promise holds (the backend selection is set explicitly per session) or the documentation and the comment name the settings that are inherited and why.

## Actual

Backend sandbox mode is inherited from the user's configuration. Inheriting it does not itself weaken the authored sandbox permissions, so this is a contract and documentation gap rather than a confirmed permission defect.

## Fix shape

Narrow the promise in docs/06 and `options.ts`, or define the backend explicitly in the session options and test that the machine setting is ignored.

## Related

#102 (record `docs/qa/2026-10-19-wp-f5-launch-diagnosis.md`), docs/06 "Windows notes".


## Intent 4 delivery admission — November 21

Admitted after [intent 3 engineering delivery](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/279#issuecomment-7059784448) on signed main `02351e2fb932b3be44e7cc3fb3943a61d568226c`, under the owner's ordered batch and delegated blocker-decision authority. [D171 and its alternatives](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/427#issuecomment-7059806202) distinguish coordinator selection from human plan approval. Historical parking text above remains history.

Reconcile documentation with the actual inherited Windows sandbox behavior. Do not change permissions/backend behavior or turn the documentation mismatch into an unsupported security claim.

Implementation and opposite-family review use the named routing models at xhigh. **Independent QA agent (planned):** `i4_365_behavior_qa`, a separate context and checkout; actual provider/session/build/evidence will be recorded when dispatched. GPT owns architecture; Claude Code contributes implementation, design critique, QA and adversarial review. Preserve touched-system positive/negative QA, unchanged coverage, current-head/current-target CI, fresh independent Astra MAX final audit and the three-general-scan cap. No implementation, QA or acceptance is implied by admission. Owner-only closure obligations and held460/Mac501 remain separate.
